snippet.title: Project P.I.T.T. Reveal Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcing Project P.I.T.T. an upcoming physics sandbox game where you have to put rubber ducks into a pit.

Wishlist on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/4026250/Project_PITT/
Test the demo on Itchio https://fr0ke.itch.io/project-pitt-demo
